title: Inventory and retrofit of console edge-case traces and metric ownership
creator: Ava Chen
description: After the March 2nd capacity incident where the Console front-end reported stale route-level metrics and the tenant heatmap showed zeros for affected shards, we discovered several ‘edge-case’ failure paths with no tracepoints and missing tenant-scoped metrics. This ticket tracks a full inventory of affected dashboards, assigns metric/trace ownership, and implements retrofit instrumentation and a lightweight runbook to prevent recurrence. Goal: ensure end-to-end visibility for tail-latency, queue depth, and prefix/KV-cache eviction signals at tenant and route granularity.
acceptance_criteria: Complete inventory CSV (dashboard, panel id, missing metric/trace) uploaded to Confluence and linked
Owners assigned for each missing metric/trace (team + primary contact)
At least 6 high-risk dashboards updated to emit tenant-scoped tail-latency and queue-depth metrics with new tracepoints instrumented
Sampling/ingestion cost estimate and mitigation plan documented for tail sampling
Runbook created and validated with SRE (play: detect -> triage -> remediate) and linked in incident runbooks
One end-to-end test (synthetic traffic) demonstrates the new tracepoint + dashboard panels capture a simulated saturation event

2026-02-15 Priya Kapoor (SRE): Reviewed list and recommended adding a synthetic load test harness entry to validate tracepoints. Suggested sampling strategy to avoid 5x ingestion spike. SRE will review runbook draft.

2026-02-24 Mateo Rivera: Staging soak results: tracepoint emitted successfully but high-cardinality alert triggered due to tenant_id dimension. Added tag-limiting and bucketed quantiles to PR. Re-queued for staging validation.

2026-03-02 Incident reference: capacity spike on 2026-03-02 (INC-2026-031). During the incident, dashboards for affected tenants rendered zeros because panels used aggregate metrics without tenant dimension. This ticket is a direct follow-up.
2026-03-05 Design review: UX/PM asked for a new dashboard panel template that shows tenant-percentile ribbons (p50/p90/p99) and queue-depth heatmap. Action: Design to provide mockups by Mar 12.

2026-03-09 Mateo Rivera: Work-in-progress: added tracing hook for KV-cache eviction path (node-cache service). Instrumented 'kv.eviction.reason' and 'kv.eviction.tenant_id'. Small regression found in a simulated cold-start path; temporary fallback added to ensure instrumentation doesn't impact latency.

2026-03-11 Ava Chen: Draft runbook uploaded to Confluence. Contains detection play (missing tenant telemetry), triage checklist (compare shard-level metrics, examine ingress.queue_depth_per_tenant), and remediation steps (enable synthetic tracepoint capture, roll forward change, toggle-bucket sampling).
